summary: Tested the new employee quick-add-vendor feature end-to-end. Backend: added TestQuickVendor class (8 tests) covering employee create + persistence, case-insensitive idempotency, min-length validation (422), admin blocked from quick-add (403), unauthenticated blocked (401), employee still blocked from full vendor mgmt POST/PUT (403) after quick-add is enabled, and end-to-end collection creation using a quick-created vendor. Full backend suite is now 51 passed / 1 skipped (seed idempotency by design). Frontend Playwright as Raj Mehta (+91 98765 42100 / RajSecure@2026): opened Record-a-collection form, clicked toggle-quick-vendor-button, typed a unique business name (TEST_UI_Vendor_<ts>), clicked quick-vendor-save-button — new vendor was auto-selected in collection-vendor-select (value is the new UUID, option text contains the new name; option count grew by 1). Re-added same name -> option count stayed at 1 (idempotent). Full page reload -> new vendor still present in options (persisted). Then created a real quick vendor + amount 55 UPI collection -> success toast 'Collection recorded successfully' and receipt modal LFC-2607-EBE5B with VENDOR = TEST_UI_Collect_<ts>. Mobile 390x844: quick-vendor-form renders without horizontal overflow of the panel (documentElement widths measured). All 7 acceptance criteria in the review pass.

minor.issue: Case-insensitive dedupe uses raw user input inside a $regex without escaping. A name containing regex meta-characters (e.g. 'A.B*', 'A|B') would cause an unintended broad match or a regex-compile error. Wrap the name with re.escape(...) before building the ^...$ pattern.

Existing-vendor branch returns the raw Mongo document via response_model=Vendor. If any historical vendor doc is missing required VendorCreate fields (name/business_name/phone/address of correct length), FastAPI would raise a 500 during serialization. Consider defensive defaults or a $set-on-upsert path.
No trim/collapse of internal whitespace: 'Acme   Traders' vs 'Acme Traders' are treated as different vendors. Consider normalising whitespace before dedupe.

Placeholder phone 'Not provided' violates VendorCreate.phone min_length=8 semantically (though it slips through because Vendor(**...) validates only min_length=8 characters and 'Not provided' is 12 chars). Admin edit UI will see this as a normal phone — mildly confusing UX.

action_items: (Recommended) Escape regex meta-characters in the dedupe query in POST /api/vendors/quick-add (use re.escape(name)).
(Optional) Normalize whitespace (collapse runs of spaces, trim) before both dedupe lookup and vendor creation so 'Acme  Traders' == 'Acme Traders'.

(Optional) Replace 'Not provided' / 'Added from the field' placeholder strings with empty strings and relax VendorCreate min_length for phone/address when quick-created, OR flag such records with source='quick-add' so admin UI can prompt for completion.

React dev-mode hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' comes from Emergent visual-editor's x-ve-dynamic span injection inside <option>{vendor.business_name}</option>. Cosmetic dev-only warning; consider suppressing by making the option child a plain string template literal that visual editor won't wrap, OR ignore as it's an editor artifact.
critical_code_review_comments: router.py quick_add_vendor: user-supplied string is interpolated into a MongoDB $regex without escaping — inject risk & correctness bug (see backend_issues.minor).

router.py quick_add_vendor: dedupe compares business_name only; but Vendor model has both name and business_name set to the same value. That is fine for the current feature but if admin later renames business_name only, subsequent quick-add of the original name will not dedupe. Not fixable without additional metadata.
Placeholder values 'Not provided' / 'Added from the field' bleed into admin vendor management UI. Cleaner to mark records with a source='quick' flag.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for quick-add flow (auto-select, idempotency, reload persistence, full collection submission all verified via Playwright)

Frontend selectors: toggle-quick-vendor-button, quick-vendor-form, quick-vendor-name-input, quick-vendor-save-button, collection-vendor-select. Quick-add auto-selects by setting collection.vendor_id + vendor_name in EmployeePortal.jsx line 61. Backend contract: POST /api/vendors/quick-add {name} -> Vendor (200). Employee-only (403 for admin/anon). Case-insensitive dedupe on business_name.
rca of the issue: No functional defect. Feature meets all 7 acceptance criteria. Only hardening suggestions: (a) escape regex meta-chars in dedupe query, (b) normalize whitespace, (c) placeholder phone/address values bleed into admin UI.
